title: Console backend endpoints for Dedicated staged rollouts: timeline, gate evidence, promote/abort (RBAC)
creator: Jada Williams
project: Dedicated staged rollouts for reserved pools
description:
Implement Console-facing backend endpoints to support Dedicated staged rollout workflows:
- Render rollout timeline and stage states for a Dedicated pool
- Retrieve gate evidence (queries + windows + observed values + pass/fail reasoning)
- Execute actions (promote/abort/hold/force-promote where allowed) with RBAC + audit logging

This is the Console backend contract consumed by the stage timeline component and gate evidence panel.
body:
## Background
Dedicated staged rollouts introduces a first-class staged rollout plan per reserved pool. Console needs a consistent read model (timeline + evidence) and a safe action surface (promote/abort/hold + admin override) with deterministic behavior and full auditability.

This ticket is specifically about the **Console backend** API layer (BFF) that:
1) Calls the control-plane rollouts service (DedicatedPoolRollouts) for plan + state.
2) Calls policy engine / gate evaluation for evidence.
3) Enforces Console RBAC and ensures **all mutations emit audit events**.

## Goals
- Provide a stable Console contract for:
  - Rollout timeline rendering (stages, current stage, state machine, annotations)
  - Gate evidence drilldown per stage
  - Allowed actions + guardrails (who can click what, when)
- Ensure **RBAC** covers:
  - Customer admin vs Redwood operator vs Redwood admin override
- Ensure **audit trail completeness**:
  - create/update handled elsewhere; this ticket focuses on promote/abort/hold/force-promote surfaces
- Ensure action endpoints are safe under retries (idempotency) and safe under concurrent UI users (optimistic concurrency)

## Non-goals
- Building the Console UI (tracked separately)
- Implementing gate evaluation logic (policy engine)
- Implementing routing split behavior (data plane)
- Customer-configurable custom gate metrics (v1 is Redwood-defined allowlist)

## API surface (Console BFF)
**Base:** /console/v1/dedicated/pools/{pool_id}/rollouts/{rollout_id}

### 1) Timeline endpoint
- GET /timeline

Returns a Console-ready timeline object (stages ordered, current_stage, rollout_state, and per-stage gate summary + stage start/promotion timestamps if available).

Response fields must be stable for the DES-431 timeline component:
- rollout_id, pool_id, rollout_state: DRAFT | RUNNING | HELD | ABORTED | COMPLETED
- stage list (ordered): stage_id, name, allocation (traffic_percent or replica_partition), state: PENDING | ACTIVE | PASSED | FAILED | SKIPPED
- summary: current_stage_id, created_by, started_at, last_updated_at
- annotations: last_action, last_actor, last_reason (if present)

### 2) Gate evidence endpoint
- GET /stages/{stage_id}/gate-evidence

Returns evidence used to decide whether stage gates are passing, including:
- evaluation_window: start/end timestamps, staleness indicator
- per-gate results (allowlisted):
  - error_rate (5xx + policy-defined retryable failures)
  - p95/p99 latency
  - saturation/headroom (GPU util, queue depth proxy)
  - OOM rate
  - request drops / 429s
  - optional quality regression metrics where enabled
- each gate includes: query reference, observed value(s), threshold(s), sample size, pass/fail/unknown + explanation

Important: evidence must be explicit about **UNKNOWN** due to missing/stale telemetry and must include a recommended operator action (e.g., “Telemetry stale (>3m). Gate evaluation defaulting to fail-closed; use hold or force-promote if approved.”)

### 3) Action endpoints
All action endpoints must:
- Require RBAC checks
- Emit audit events (actor, role, reason, old/new stage/state)
- Require an idempotency key (Idempotency-Key header)
- Use optimistic concurrency via ETag/If-Match on rollout version where supported by control plane

Actions:
- POST /actions/promote
  - body: reason (required), expected_current_stage_id (optional but recommended)
- POST /actions/abort
  - body: reason (required)
- POST /actions/hold
  - body: reason (required)
- POST /actions/resume
  - body: reason (required)

Admin-only overrides (if enabled for v1 scope; must be hidden unless permission present):
- POST /actions/force-promote
  - body: reason (required), override_ticket (optional), acknowledge_risk (required true)

The BFF should also expose computed fields on timeline for UI enable/disable:
- can_promote, can_abort, can_hold, can_force_promote, requires_admin
- block reasons (strings) when disabled (e.g., “Stage gates failing: error_rate”, “Telemetry stale”, “Rollout is HELD”, “Insufficient permission”) 

## RBAC rules (Console)
This ticket uses existing Console authn/authz integration.

Proposed permissions (align with Kaitlyn Nguyen review):
- dedicated.rollouts.view: view timeline + evidence
- dedicated.rollouts.operate: promote/abort/hold/resume (customer admin + Redwood operator)
- dedicated.rollouts.override: force-promote (Redwood admin only)

Notes:
- Customer admins can operate on their own pools only.
- Redwood operators can operate on pools they have support access to (existing support access controls).
- Force-promote must require explicit override permission and must always write an audit event with reason.

## Integration details
- Control-plane service: DedicatedPoolRollouts
  - used for: get rollout plan/state, perform promote/abort/hold/resume
- Policy engine gate evaluation:
  - used for: stage gate summaries + evidence details
  - ensure we pass (pool_id, rollout_id, stage_id, region) consistently to avoid evidence/timeline mismatches

## Failure handling & determinism
- Timeline reads should be resilient and return partial data if gate evidence system is temporarily unavailable (e.g., show gates as UNKNOWN with explanation).
- Mutations must be deterministic:
  - if promote called twice with same Idempotency-Key, return the same result
  - if UI is behind and tries to promote from an older stage, return 409 with current stage + guidance

## Observability
- Emit structured logs for all action calls:
  - actor_id, account_id, pool_id, rollout_id, stage_id, action, result, latency, upstream request ids
- Metrics:
  - console_rollouts_action_total{action,result}
  - console_rollouts_action_latency_ms{action}
  - console_rollouts_evidence_fetch_total{result}

## Acceptance criteria
- Console can render a timeline for any rollout plan (draft/running/held/aborted/completed)
- Console can fetch gate evidence per stage and see pass/fail/unknown with explanations
- Promote/abort/hold/resume endpoints enforce RBAC and return clear errors for unauthorized actors
- Force-promote available only to override permission holders; requires explicit risk acknowledgement
- All actions generate audit events with required fields (actor, reason, old/new stage/state)
- Idempotency + optimistic concurrency prevents double-promote under retries

## Test plan
- Unit tests:
  - RBAC matrix for each endpoint
  - idempotency key behavior for action endpoints
  - 409 on stale stage promotion
- Integration tests (with rollouts service + policy engine stubs):
  - create plan elsewhere → run timeline → promote → timeline updates
  - evidence endpoint returns UNKNOWN when telemetry stale
- Manual verification:
  - use beta flag account and validate Console UI can populate both timeline and evidence panels

## Rollout plan
- Behind feature flag: console.dedicatedStagedRollouts
- Enable for internal Dedicated pools first
- Enable for 1–2 beta accounts after SRE + Security signoff

## Links
- Confluence design spec: staged-rollouts-for-dedicated-pools-design-spec
- ADRs:
  - adr-gate-evaluation-signals-and-thresholds
  - adr-rollback-and-abort-semantics-for-dedicated-rollouts
- Related PR (implementation): github/redwood/pr-28564-console-rollout-timeline-and-gate-evidence-endpoints
- Follow-up PR (admin overrides): github/redwood/pr-28592-add-force-promote-and-hold-with-admin-guardrails
acceptance_criteria: GET timeline returns ordered stage list with rollout state and per-stage gate summary suitable for Console rendering
GET gate-evidence returns per-gate observed values, thresholds, evaluation window, and explicit UNKNOWN reasons when applicable
POST promote/abort/hold/resume enforce RBAC and create audit events; return 409 for stale stage promotion attempts
Action endpoints are idempotent via Idempotency-Key and safe under concurrent callers (optimistic concurrency / version checks)
Force-promote is admin-only and requires explicit acknowledge_risk=true plus audit logging
comments: 2025-02-12 (Chloe Martin): Drafted initial endpoint shapes based on DES-431 needs. Waiting on final evidence schema from eng-platform thread; will keep timeline contract stable and version evidence if needed.

2025-02-14 (Kaitlyn Nguyen): Security note: ensure support-access checks for Redwood operators are enforced server-side (not only UI). Force-promote must be separate permission and always include reason in audit event; no empty reasons.

2025-02-18 (Jordan Lee): Evidence endpoint should not re-run heavy queries on every request; please add caching (short TTL) keyed by (rollout_id, stage_id, window). Mark evidence with evaluated_at and staleness.
2025-02-21 (Logan Wright): Telemetry labels: use stage_id (not stage_name) to avoid cardinality drift. Ensure evidence endpoint surfaces the exact tag set used so UI can debug mismatches.
2025-02-27 (Jada Williams): Please include can_* fields + disable reasons in timeline response. Console shouldn’t need to replicate state machine logic client-side.

2025-03-03 (Chloe Martin): Implemented timeline + evidence + action endpoints behind flag; added 409 protection on promote when expected_current_stage_id mismatches. Added Idempotency-Key enforcement on actions.

2025-03-06 (Rafael Mendes): Reviewed error messages: add operator guidance when gates UNKNOWN due to telemetry lag (recommend HOLD rather than force-promote). Also confirm audit events emitted for HOLD/RESUME.
2025-03-10 (Chloe Martin): PR up: redwood/pr-28564. Includes structured logging + metrics. Pending final review from Kaitlyn for RBAC edge cases.

2025-03-13 (Kaitlyn Nguyen): Approved with changes: ensure force-promote endpoint is not discoverable via timeline unless permission present; response should omit can_force_promote field entirely or return false + 'admin only'.
2025-03-14 (Chloe Martin): Merged + verified in staging with internal pool. Marking Done; follow-ups tracked for UI polish and audit export pipeline.
resolution: Merged implementation in PR-28564. Endpoints enabled behind console.dedicatedStagedRollouts flag for internal pools; beta enablement pending program approvals.

ENG-5995: end-to-end QA automation should cover stale telemetry → UNKNOWN gates → HOLD behavior
